name: Azariah
bio: Azariah, chief priest of Zadok's house, served under King Hezekiah of Judah. When the people's firstfruits and tithes piled up in heaps for months after Hezekiah called on them to support the priesthood properly, the king asked about it, and Azariah reported that the LORD had blessed the people so abundantly that the priests had plenty to eat with a great surplus left over (2 Chronicles 31:10). He is a different figure from the earlier priest Azariah who confronted King Uzziah over his unlawful incense offering.
